description: This file provides functionality for transcoding JPEG images, including error handling, image resizing, quality adjustment, and normalization of EXIF orientation. It defines a specific enum for errors and a struct with static methods for processing image data.

classes.name: JPEGTranscodeError
classes.description: An enumeration representing possible errors during JPEG transcoding, including failure to decode, missing properties, failure to encode, and size limit exceeded.

classes.name: JPEGTranscoder
classes.description: A utility struct providing static methods for transcoding JPEG images, including quality clamping and the main transcode method that downscales and recompresses images to meet specified constraints.

methods.name: clampQuality
methods.description: Clamps the quality parameter between 0.05 and 1.0.

methods.name: transcodeToJPEG
methods.description: Main method to re-encode an image data to JPEG, optionally downscaling to a maximum width and size, adjusting quality as needed, and normalizing orientation.
